reference.question: Across category, how do holding value and holding gain compare using two related tables?
reference.sql_query:
WITH 
    holding AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS holding_count,
             SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value,
             SUM(current_value-cost) AS total_holding_gain,
             AVG(returns_pct) AS avg_returns_pct,
             SUM(dividends) AS total_dividends,
             SUM(taxes_paid) AS total_taxes_paid
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.category, ROUND(AVG(holding.total_holding_value),2) AS avg_holding_value, ROUND(AVG(holding.total_holding_gain),2) AS avg_holding_gain FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN holding ON holding.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.category;
reference.sql_reason: Holdings are pre-aggregated per investor in a CTE before the join, correctly neutralizing fan-out.

reference.question: Across profile category, how do goal progress, health risk, and liquidity compare using three related tables?
reference.sql_query:
WITH goal AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS goal_count,
             AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress_pct,
             AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall,
             AVG(avg_sharpe_ratio) AS avg_sharpe_ratio,
             AVG(avg_volatility_pct) AS avg_volatility_pct,
             AVG(time_to_goal_months) AS avg_time_to_goal_months
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.category AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_progress_pct),2) AS avg_progress_pct, ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score, ROUND(AVG(h.liquidity_score),2) AS avg_liquidity_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.category;
reference.sql_reason: goal CTE pre-aggregates and health is 1:1 per investor, so no fan-out; all three metrics returned.

reference.question: Across time_horizon, how do goal shortfall, allocation concentration, health liquidity, and diversification compare using four related tables?
reference.sql_query:
WITH goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.time_horizon AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall, ROUND(AVG(alloc.max_allocation_pct),2) AS avg_max_allocation_pct, ROUND(AVG(h.liquidity_score),2) AS avg_liquidity_score, ROUND(AVG(h.diversification_score),2) AS avg_diversification_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN alloc ON alloc.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.time_horizon;
reference.sql_reason: Goal and allocation tables are pre-aggregated per investor before 1:1 joins to profile and health, and all four metrics (shortfall, concentration, liquidity, diversification) are output.
